snapshot.title: Add interactive mining tutorial with pause
snapshot.description: Tutorial should pause rocket movement, guide user to mine surface deposits (explain colors), then teach drone usage for subsurface deposits before allowing continuation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Tutorial explains mineral colors and values

changes.newValue: Implemented interactive tutorial: INTRO → mine Iron → mine Nickel → explain subsurface → deploy drone → complete. Rocket pauses (_tutorial_paused) during each step. Tracks _surface_mined_count to progress. Explains mineral colors and drone usage.
